standard.title: 建筑节能与可再生能源利用通用规范
standard.pages: Printed pages 4–17: envelope tables; 62–64: Appendix B definitions; 69–77: reference operation
standard.scope: Normative limits and selected reference conditions only. This library is a simulation scenario, not a building compliance certificate. U includes reference surface films and structural thermal bridges; materials are equivalent homogenized assumptions. Partition/unheated-basement limits are retained for future boundary extensions and are not applied to adiabatic boundaries; entrance doors and balcony panels are outside this adapter scope.

assumptions.notes: Capacities are full-construction J/(m2 K), split at shared adiabatic midplanes. Glass is massless; summer equivalent optics use alpha=0.1, tau=max(SHGC_limit-alpha,0), rho=1-SHGC_limit, so tau+alpha<=limit. This does not reproduce a measured glazing product or winter SHGC. Ground insulation R is added to assumed base R; full-floor use of peripheral minimum is a scenario assumption. Unknown table columns use the stricter limit. Default public aliases select class A; select B explicitly only after checking Appendix B area/group-area criteria. Climate aliases select subzone A and do not infer a site climate classification. Residential cooling COP 3.6 outside cold-B/hot-summer reference climates is an engineering extension. Storey count from model levels is an estimate. Normative limits do not prove compliance after explicit model overrides.

residential_mild_B.applicability: Window U applies to east/west only; using it for all directions is a conservative scenario assumption.

OFFICE.assumptions: Monday-first typical week; no statutory holidays or setpoint ramps. Residential uses living-room profiles as a representative zone, without bedroom weighting. Public background infiltration 0.5 ACH and people sensible heat 75 W/person are engineering assumptions. Heating COP 2.6 is an assumed heat-pump scenario, not a national all-climate requirement. Cooling COP is a reference conversion, not a certified product value.
